rules.description: Magento Static, Media & Swatch Ajax Assets Edge + Browser Cache (30d TTL, ignore Vary/session cookies)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.smokeday.com" "smokeday.com"}) and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/media/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/swatches/ajax/media") or http.request.uri.path in {"/favicon.ico" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml"})

rules.description: Magento Bypass Dynamic, Admin, API & Personalized Vary Cookies
rules.expression: ((not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/index.php") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/startrek")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/a79d3342ca_admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customer")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sales")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wishlist")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/rest")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/graphql")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/paypal")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/braintree")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sezzle")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogsearch")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/contact")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customform")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.php/api")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wholesale")) or (http.cookie contains "X-Magento-Vary=") or (http.cookie contains "login_as_customer")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/media/")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/swatches/ajax/media")) and (not http.request.uri.path in {"/favicon.ico" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml"})

rules.description: Magento Guest Storefront HTML Edge Cache
rules.expression: (http.host eq "www.smokeday.com") and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/blog") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/free-stuff") or http.request.uri.path in {"/faqs" "/faq" "/about-online-head-shop" "/customer-service" "/shipping-policy" "/returns-refund-policy" "/terms-and-conditions" "/ships-from-usa" "/bongs" "/privacy-policy-cookie-restriction-mode" "/enable-cookies"}) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/media/")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/startrek")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/a79d3342ca_admin")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customer")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sales")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wishlist")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/rest")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/graphql")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/paypal")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/braintree")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sezzle")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogsearch")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/contact")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customform")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wholesale")) and (not http.cookie contains "X-Magento-Vary=") and (not http.cookie contains "login_as_customer")

rules.description: Normalize Magento Marketing Tracking Query Parameters (preserve pagination & filters)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "www.smokeday.com") and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and (http.request.uri.query contains "gclid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "fbclid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "msclkid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "srsltid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "gbraid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "wbraid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "dclid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "utm_" or http.request.uri.query contains "mc_cid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "mc_eid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "_ga=" or http.request.uri.query contains "_gl=" or http.request.uri.query contains "twclid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "ttclid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "yclid=" or http.request.uri.query contains "_bta_" or http.request.uri.query contains "trk_" or http.request.uri.query contains "gdf" or http.request.uri.query contains "_ke=" or http.request.uri.query contains "kx=" or http.request.uri.query contains "dm_i=" or http.request.uri.query contains "ef_id=" or http.request.uri.query contains "s_kwcid=")
